card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or opening parenthesis) right before a dose amount such as 60 mg/kg/day or 10 to 15 mg/kg. It appears in valproate and phenytoin dosing sentences, after words like "of", "is", "at" or "above".

modes.label: Space before dose range
modes.description: A blank token after a linking word, just before a number and mg unit giving a dose or range.
modes.example: In adults, a loading dose of<< >>10 to 15 mg/kg

modes.label: Space before maximum dose
modes.description: A blank token before the maximum recommended daily dose in mg/kg/day.
modes.example: No recommendation regarding the safety of valproate for use at doses above<< >>60 mg/kg/day can be made

modes.label: Parenthesis before strengths
modes.description: An opening parenthesis before tablet strengths in an interaction sentence.
